parts.title: Campus Conversation: The Lost and Found Office
script: Listen to a conversation between a student and a worker at the campus lost and found office.
Hello. I lost my blue backpack. Can you help me?
Of course. Where did you lose it?
I think I left it in the science building yesterday.
There is a laptop, two notebooks, and a water bottle.
Let me check. Oh, someone brought a blue backpack this morning.
Really? That is great news! Can I see it?
Yes. But first, I need to see your student ID. Then you must write your name on this form.
Here is my ID. Oh no, I forgot my pen.
No problem. You can use mine.
Thank you so much. I was very worried about my laptop.
Next time, please put your name on your bag. It is easier for us to find the owner.
Good idea. I will do that today.

questions.q: Why does the student talk to the man?
o: To ask about her lost backpack

questions.q: Where does the student think she lost the backpack?
questions.exp: She left it in the science building.

questions.q: What does the student need to show the man?
questions.exp: He needs to see her student ID.

questions.q: Why does the man say, "You can use mine"?
o: He offers his pen to her
He wants her to take his bag
He wants to use her laptop
questions.exp: She forgot her pen, so he offers his.

questions.q: What does the man suggest the student do next time?
o: Write her name on her bag
questions.exp: He says to put your name on your bag.

parts.title: Academic Lecture: Why Are Spiders Helpful?
script: Listen to part of a lecture in a biology class.
Today we will talk about spiders. Many people are afraid of spiders. But spiders are very helpful animals.
First, spiders are not insects. An insect has six legs. A spider has eight legs.
Second, most spiders make webs. A web is like a net. It is made of silk. The spider makes silk inside its body.
The web catches small insects, like flies and mosquitoes. Then the spider eats them.
This is very useful for people. Spiders eat many insects that bother us. Some insects also eat farm plants. So spiders help farmers too.
Now, some people think all spiders are dangerous. This is not true. Only a few spiders can hurt people. Most spiders are harmless.
Finally, spider silk is very strong. Scientists are studying it. They want to make strong, light clothes from silk.
So, remember. Spiders have eight legs, they make silk, and they help us by eating insects.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
questions.exp: The lecture is about helpful spiders.

questions.q: How many legs does a spider have?
What is a spider web made of?

o: They eat insects that hurt plants
questions.exp: Spiders eat insects that eat farm plants.

questions.q: Why does the professor say, "A web is like a net"?
o: To explain what a web is
To show a spider is big
questions.exp: He explains what a web is.
